DeterminationBasis: Existing T08 tests establish generic determination/execution separation and explicit semantics for ALLOW and HOLD, but none directly establishes the normative semantics of DENY. DENY requires an established prohibition within the declared governance scope and must remain distinguishable from unresolved uncertainty, HOLD, absence of permission or another determination state. This remains a distinct positive determination-semantics test gap.

Existing T08 tests do not directly establish the normative semantics of ESCALATE. ESCALATE must identify or reference a separately authorised process and must not itself confer consequential execution authority unless the governing policy explicitly establishes that authority. The distinction between escalation routing and execution authority therefore remains a separate positive and negative test obligation.
